note: Canonical marker genes for interpreting cluster identity. Cell-type labels are NOT given -- expression_matrix.csv has no ground-truth column. You must cluster the cells yourself and interpret each cluster's identity from these marker groups.
warning: Epithelial-marker positivity ALONE does not mean malignant -- a normal, non-cancerous epithelial population can also express EPCAM/KRT8/KRT18/CDH1 highly. Malignancy additionally requires elevated proliferation markers together with reduced tumor-suppressor marker expression, consistent with loss of cell-cycle checkpoint control. Do not flag a cluster as malignant on epithelial markers alone -- check proliferation and tumor-suppressor markers too.
